summary: One test failed due to a locator not finding the expected element on the contact form page.
rootCause: The test failed because the locator '[data-test="nav-contact"]' did not find any visible element within the timeout period, indicating a possible mismatch between the selector used in the test and the actual application DOM.

failedTests.testName: TC-001: Verify accessibility of the contact form
failedTests.errorMessage: Error: expect(locator('[data-test="nav-contact"]')).toBeVisible() failed - element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' does not match any visible element on the page, possibly due to changes in the application UI or incorrect selector in the test.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' is correct and matches the current application DOM. Update the selector if the application UI has changed. Also, confirm that the page URL and navigation are correct before the assertion.

recommendations: Review and validate the selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' against the current application UI.
Check if the application page at `${baseURL}/contact` loads correctly and contains the expected element.
If the application UI has changed, update the test selectors accordingly.
Consider adding debug logs or screenshots (already attached) to assist in diagnosing the issue.
Run the test locally to verify if the failure is reproducible outside the CI environment.
releaseImpact: High - The failure indicates a broken test that verifies critical accessibility of the contact form, potentially blocking release until resolved.
